scope: Two route-free Linux namespace runs using official MCP SDK 2.3.1 as the client and the development server binary; not an installed package or native Codex, Claude, or Cursor workflow
checks: A fresh server received 52 serial approved calls, sixteen concurrent SDK submissions with eight per-host slots left, a serial fill to exactly 60 approved calls, and a final rate-limited call. The SDK checked each result and a bounded redacted audit. Fixture counters required exactly 60 allowed.test A and AAAA queries and 60 /plain HTTP hits; denied and busy requests added none. Each full route-free suite passed 3457 decisions.
limitations: Client submissions are concurrent, but server execution is not proven simultaneous. Fixture counters are not a host-wide packet capture. No installed package lifecycle, arbitrary scheduler, multi-process budget, native Codex/Claude/Cursor, other-tool traffic, exact official candidate, owner acceptance, independent human review, or AI Scraping Defense repository is covered.
